scope: Complete vehicleUnstuck helper and WAIT ordinary recovery issue/handback branches; not whole HBQ parity

findings.evidence: Header promises fuel recovery, flipping and eventual recreation. Actual helper contains no setFuel or recreation branch; level two expressly avoids flipping/lifting and level three relocates the existing object. Null vehicle/group returns true.
findings.disposition: Do not infer capabilities or success from comments/handled return. Distinguish issued command, observed progress and failed recovery.

findings.evidence: Uses current waypoint only when index >0; otherwise accepts expectedDestination when method is not DoNotPlan and X is nonzero. Reissues doMove and setCurrentWaypoint; PATH is unconditionally enabled.
findings.disposition: Retain avoidance of index-zero start-position routing. Reject resetting intentional PATH disable or replacing authored waits/scripts/attached orders. WAIT ordinary recovery requires full unchanged route/seat/command receipts and plain MOVE eligibility; direct script-order recovery remains a separate gap.

findings.evidence: Dead/missing driver selects first alive nonplayer conscious crew member, moves dead driver out, sleeps one second, then uses moveToDriver if actor/vehicle alive, seat empty and actor still aboard. Helper does not check local ownership, generation, route, specialist ownership or newer seat assignment in the callback.
findings.disposition: Retain conscious-driver replacement intent and seat vacancy recheck. Do not copy delayed seat mutation without actor/vehicle owner and assignment receipts. Existing WAIT crew controller must be traced separately; this review grants no seat-handover acceptance.

findings.evidence: Optional mobility repair matches wheel/track/engine/fuel/rotor/transmission/damper substrings and sets matched hitpoints to zero when canMove is false.
findings.disposition: Administrative repair is not natural driving recovery. No implicit repair or damage erasure for WAIT ordinary recovery.

findings.evidence: Level two calls rearClear then push for 2.5m over0.8s if not flying and upright. Level three lifts flying aircraft30m and writes forward model velocity60; land/ship fallback relocates and resets velocity/up vector.
findings.disposition: Reject physics/teleport shortcuts for ordinary physical recovery. WAIT currently issues an8m rear doMove after fresh clearance, but native reverse versus U-turn is unproven; class-specific diagnostics are prepared, not run.

findings.evidence: Fallback scans vehicles/wrecks/props/people/moving traffic, excludes nearby reserved teleport spots for30s, then mutates transform in one unscheduled block.
findings.disposition: Useful intent is collision-aware placement and finite reservation. Local missionNamespace spot list is not cross-owner arbitration. Do not import teleport mechanics or call them queue coordination.

findings.evidence: DrivingAssistStart uses refresh/rear/final stages with fixed journal deadline, route progress requirement and separate traffic retry budget; DrivingRecoveryRelease checks driver/operator destination, route and native STOP before handback.
findings.disposition: Retain finite stages and authored intent. Missing physical native reverse capability and multi-owner queue-room operation remain open. No production change in this review.
